# Visio 2003

Visio 2003 follows the [Fixed](/en-us/lifecycle/policies/fixed) Lifecycle Policy.

This applies to the following editions: Professional, Standard

Support dates are shown in the Pacific Time Zone (PT) - Redmond, WA, USA.

| Visio 2003 | 11/17/2003 8:00:00 AM | 4/15/2009 6:59:59 AM | 4/9/2014 6:59:59 AM |
